in_marathi.name: Drishana
in_marathi.long_meaning: Drishana हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Sanskrit, Drishana means observer or seer. This name is derived from the root 'drsh', which means to see. It is a name given to those who are considered wise, perceptive, and insightful.
